title: [review] provisioning.py:540: provision_node() does not
description: Unlike _handle_br_post() which invokes self._provisioned_callback on success (lines 365-377), provision_node() never calls the callback. Callers using provision_node() will not trigger the on_provisioned() callback to register the node, creating an inconsistency in the BR's state depending on which API path was used.
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-swqy. Fixed in same change - provision_node() now invokes _provisioned_callback after ACK verification.
